q1_issues.issue: (CardinalityPhrase sk_group_1 "some") is not licensed — CardinalityPhrase is specified for a closed set of vague-count phrases ("a few / several / a handful / dozens / scores / hundreds / a lot of") normalized to the canonical lexicon string, whereas "some Ns" is given the plain existential/group encoding.
The quantifier is recorded on the first conjunct's group only — sk_group_2 gets no quantifier atom at all — so the coordination is treated asymmetrically.

q2_gaps: Spatial prepositions outside "in / at / on": "around the post" answers "where" (so the role test selects Location) yet Location is defined only over in/at/on while the competing mechanical rule says to keep the preposition actually used, and the instruction set never says which wins.
Scope of a determiner over a coordinated NP ("Some A and B"): nothing states whether the quantifier distributes to both conjuncts or attaches to the first only.
notes: The inception pattern (begin event + Past, activity witness + Ongoing under Theme), the distributive coordination with one shared object symbol, the compound genus plus adjectival-modifier decompositions, and the Location-on-the-event-only rule for a creation event are all followed correctly. The modifier genus (Inheritance european_american_settler european_american) stops at a two-word part, short of the "decompose to single-word lemmas, then stop" requirement.
